name: econexus
description: EcoNexus : plateforme IA Eau · Énergie · Agriculture (monorepo frontend + backend)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run db:migrate --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
